start.speaker: guildmistress_anya
start.text: You've the look of road-hardened folk. My caravan left for the Thornwood eleven days ago — silks, salt, and my sister's dowry chest. It never arrived.

offer.speaker: guildmistress_anya
offer.text: Find what became of it. Whatever bandits left behind, the guild will trade you steel worth keeping for its return. A serpent-forged blade, Thornwood work.

accept.speaker: guildmistress_anya
accept.text: The drivers favoured the south road toward the Thornwood eaves. Search the waysides — and if my people still breathe, tell them the guild hasn't forgotten them. Now: the register. I put no one on the guild's books unnamed.

choices.text: Give her a name for the register.

decline.speaker: guildmistress_anya
decline.text: Then drink your drink and mind the roads. They've grown hungry of late.
